interface.longDescription: A private, skills-only package containing 49 software-development skills from Avery-T/software-dev-skills. Includes architecture, investigation, implementation, testing, review, writing, reusable principles, and the complete supporting files. Shared model configuration preserves the collection's Astra/high oversight preference and Sol 6.1 worker preference, subject to the current host's actual capabilities and permissions. No MCP server or external account connection is included.
